item.title: ICMA Young Artist 2026 Anja Mittermüller Wins Two Emmerich Smola Prizes
item.description: Austrian mezzo-soprano Anja Mittermüller, recently named Young Artist of the Year by the International Classical Music Awards (ICMA), won the SWR Emmerich Smola Prize in Landau on January 17, alongside baritone Oleh Lebedyev. In a double victory, the Emmerich Smola Orchestra Award from the German Radio Philharmonic was also presented to Mittermüller.
